verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֣ם זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַֽיהוָ֛ה בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּכֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rā·hām zā·qên bā bay·yā·mîm Yah·weh bê·raḵ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām bak·kōl
verses.literal: By now Abraham was old and well along in years and the LORD had blessed - him in every way

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֗ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ זְקַ֣ן עַבְדּוֹ֙ בֵּית֔וֹ הַמֹּשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ שִֽׂים־ נָ֥א יָדְךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת יְרֵכִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yō·mer ’el- zə·qan ‘aḇ·dōw bê·ṯōw ham·mō·šêl bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw śîm- nā yā·ḏə·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ yə·rê·ḵî
verses.literal: So Abraham instructed . . . the chief servant of his household who managed all he owned - Place . . . your hand under my thigh

verses.original: וְאַשְׁבִּ֣יעֲךָ֔ בַּֽיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֥ב
verses.transliteration: wə·’aš·bî·‘ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haš·šā·ma·yim wê·lō·hê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî mib·bə·nō·wṯ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî bə·qir·bōw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: and I will have you swear by the LORD the God of heaven and the God of earth that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling

verses.original: כִּ֧י תֵּלֵ֑ךְ אֶל־ אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל־ מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִ֥י לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: kî tê·lêḵ ’el- ’ar·ṣî wə·’el- mō·w·laḏ·tî wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî lə·yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son Isaac

verses.original: הָעֶ֔בֶד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אוּלַי֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה לֹא־ תֹאבֶ֣ה לָלֶ֥כֶת אַחֲרַ֖י אֶל־ הַזֹּ֑את הָאָ֣רֶץ הֶֽהָשֵׁ֤ב בִּנְךָ֔ אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִשָּֽׁם׃ אֲשֶׁר־ יָצָ֥אתָ
verses.transliteration: hā·‘e·ḇeḏ way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ū·lay hā·’iš·šāh lō- ṯō·ḇeh lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·ray ’el- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ he·hā·šêḇ bin·ḵā ’ā·šîḇ ’eṯ- ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ miš·šām ’ă·šer- yā·ṣā·ṯā
verses.literal: The servant asked him What if the woman is unwilling . . . to follow me . . . to this land Shall I then take your son back . . . . . . - to the land from which you came

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־ בְּנִ֖י תָּשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā pen- bə·nî tā·šîḇ ’eṯ- šām·māh
verses.literal: Abraham replied . . . Make sure that you do not take my son back - there

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לְקָחַ֜נִי אָבִי֮ מִבֵּ֣ית מֽוֹלַדְתִּי֒ וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּר־ לִ֜י וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־ לִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַ֨רְעֲךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת־ הַזֹּ֑את הָאָ֣רֶץ ה֗וּא יִשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכוֹ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֛ה לִבְנִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haš·šā·ma·yim ’ă·šer lə·qā·ḥa·nî ’ā·ḇî mib·bêṯ mō·w·laḏ·tî ū·mê·’e·reṣ wa·’ă·šer dib·ber- lî wa·’ă·šer niš·ba‘- lî lê·mōr lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’et·tên ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ hū yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵōw lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî miš·šām
verses.literal: The LORD the God of heaven who brought me from my father’s house and my native land who spoke to me and promised me on oath . . . saying To your offspring I will give - this land He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there

verses.original: וְאִם־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ לֹ֨א תֹאבֶ֤ה לָלֶ֣כֶת אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ וְנִקִּ֕יתָ זֹ֑את מִשְּׁבֻעָתִ֖י רַ֣ק אֶת־ לֹ֥א תָשֵׁ֖ב בְּנִ֔י שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hā·’iš·šāh lō ṯō·ḇeh lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā wə·niq·qî·ṯā zōṯ miš·šə·ḇu·‘ā·ṯî raq ’eṯ- lō ṯā·šêḇ bə·nî šām·māh
verses.literal: And if the woman is unwilling . . . to follow you then you are released from this oath of mine Only - do not take my son back there

verses.original: הָעֶ֙בֶד֙ אֶת־ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם יָד֔וֹ תַּ֛חַת יֶ֥רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑יו אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיִּשָּׁ֣בַֽע ל֔וֹ עַל־ הַזֶּֽה׃ הַדָּבָ֖ר
verses.transliteration: hā·‘e·ḇeḏ ’eṯ- way·yā·śem yā·ḏōw ta·ḥaṯ ye·reḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lōw ‘al- haz·zeh had·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: So the servant - placed his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter

verses.original: הָ֠עֶבֶד וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֲשָׂרָ֨ה אֲדֹנָיו֙ גְמַלִּ֜ים מִגְּמַלֵּ֤י וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וְכָל־ ט֥וּב אֲדֹנָ֖יו בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֗קָם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ אֶל־ נָחֽוֹר׃ עִ֥יר אֲרַ֥ם נַֽהֲרַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: hā·‘e·ḇeḏ way·yiq·qaḥ ‘ă·śā·rāh ’ă·ḏō·nāw ḡə·mal·lîm mig·gə·mal·lê way·yê·leḵ wə·ḵāl ṭūḇ ’ă·ḏō·nāw bə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’el- ’el- nā·ḥō·wr ‘îr ’ă·ram na·hă·ra·yim
verses.literal: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels . . . and departed with all manner of good things from his master in hand And he set out . . . for - Nahor’s hometown vvv in Aram-naharaim

verses.original: עֶ֔רֶב לְעֵ֣ת הַגְּמַלִּ֛ים וַיַּבְרֵ֧ךְ אֶל־ בְּאֵ֣ר הַמָּ֑יִם מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר לְעֵ֖ת צֵ֥את הַשֹּׁאֲבֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘e·reḇ lə·‘êṯ hag·gə·mal·lîm way·yaḇ·rêḵ ’el- bə·’êr ham·mā·yim mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr lə·‘êṯ ṣêṯ haš·šō·’ă·ḇōṯ
verses.literal: As evening approached . . . he made the camels kneel down near the well . . . outside the town at the time when the women went out to draw water

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיֹּאמַ֓ר׀ נָ֥א הַקְרֵה־ לְפָנַ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וַעֲשֵׂה־ חֶ֕סֶד עִ֖ם אֲדֹנִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yō·mar nā haq·rêh- lə·p̄ā·nay hay·yō·wm wa·‘ă·śêh- ḥe·seḏ ‘im ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: O LORD God of my master Abraham he prayed please grant me success today . . . . . . and show kindness to my master Abraham

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וּבְנוֹת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֔יר יֹצְאֹ֖ת לִשְׁאֹ֥ב מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ‘ên ham·mā·yim ū·ḇə·nō·wṯ ’an·šê hā·‘îr yō·ṣə·’ōṯ liš·’ōḇ mā·yim
verses.literal: Here I am standing beside the spring . . . and the daughters of the townspeople . . . are coming out to draw water

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹמַ֤ר נָ֤א הַטִּי־ כַדֵּךְ֙ וְאֶשְׁתֶּ֔ה וְאָמְרָ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה אַשְׁקֶ֑ה אֹתָ֤הּ גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ וְגַם־ הֹכַ֙חְתָּ֙ לְעַבְדְּךָ֣ לְיִצְחָ֔ק וּבָ֣הּ אֵדַ֔ע כִּי־ עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֶ֖סֶד עִם־ אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh han·na·‘ă·rā ’ê·le·hā ’ă·šer ’ō·mar nā haṭ·ṭî- ḵad·dêḵ wə·’eš·teh wə·’ā·mə·rāh šə·ṯêh ’aš·qeh ’ō·ṯāh gə·mal·le·ḵā wə·ḡam- hō·ḵaḥ·tā lə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·ḇāh ’ê·ḏa‘ kî- ‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥe·seḏ ‘im- ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: Now may it happen that the girl to whom I say Please let down your jar that I may drink and who responds Drink and I will water - your camels as well let her be the one You have appointed for Your servant Isaac By this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ טֶרֶם֮ ה֗וּא כִּלָּ֣ה לְדַבֵּר֒ וְהִנֵּ֧ה רִבְקָ֣ה יֹצֵ֗את וְכַדָּ֖הּ עַל־ שִׁכְמָֽהּ׃ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֻלְּדָה֙ לִבְתוּאֵ֣ל בֶּן־ מִלְכָּ֔ה אֵ֥שֶׁת אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲחִ֣י נָח֖וֹר
verses.transliteration: way·hî- ṭe·rem hū kil·lāh lə·ḏab·bêr wə·hin·nêh riḇ·qāh yō·ṣêṯ wə·ḵad·dāh ‘al- šiḵ·māh ’ă·šer yul·lə·ḏāh liḇ·ṯū·’êl ben- mil·kāh ’ê·šeṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·ḥî nā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: - Before [the servant] had finished praying - Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor

verses.original: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ מְאֹ֔ד טֹבַ֤ת מַרְאֶה֙ בְּתוּלָ֕ה לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֑הּ וְאִ֖ישׁ וַתֵּ֣רֶד הָעַ֔יְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּ֥א כַדָּ֖הּ וַתָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·na·‘ă·rā mə·’ōḏ ṭō·ḇaṯ mar·’eh bə·ṯū·lāh lō yə·ḏā·‘āh wə·’îš wat·tê·reḏ hā·‘ay·nāh wat·tə·mal·lê ḵad·dāh wat·tā·‘al
verses.literal: Now the girl was very beautiful . . . a virgin . . . who had not had relations with any man She went down to the spring filled her jar and came up again

verses.original: הָעֶ֖בֶד וַיָּ֥רָץ לִקְרָאתָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר נָ֛א הַגְמִיאִ֥ינִי מְעַט־ מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘e·ḇeḏ way·yā·rāṣ liq·rā·ṯāh way·yō·mer nā haḡ·mî·’î·nî mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim mik·kad·dêḵ
verses.literal: So the servant ran to meet her and said Please let me have a little water from your jar

verses.original: שְׁתֵ֣ה אֲדֹנִ֑י וַתֹּ֖אמֶר וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתֹּ֧רֶד כַּדָּ֛הּ עַל־ יָדָ֖הּ וַתַּשְׁקֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ṯêh ’ă·ḏō·nî wat·tō·mer wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tō·reḏ kad·dāh ‘al- yā·ḏāh wat·taš·qê·hū
verses.literal: Drink my lord she replied and she quickly lowered her jar to her hands and gave him a drink

verses.original: וַתְּכַ֖ל לְהַשְׁקֹת֑וֹ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר גַּ֤ם אֶשְׁאָ֔ב לִגְמַלֶּ֙יךָ֙ עַ֥ד אִם־ כִּלּ֖וּ לִשְׁתֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḵal lə·haš·qō·ṯōw wat·tō·mer gam ’eš·’āḇ liḡ·mal·le·ḵā ‘aḏ ’im- kil·lū liš·tōṯ
verses.literal: After she had given him a drink she said I will also draw water for your camels until . . . they have had enough to drink

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתְּעַ֤ר כַּדָּהּ֙ אֶל־ הַשֹּׁ֔קֶת וַתָּ֥רָץ ע֛וֹד אֶֽל־ הַבְּאֵ֖ר לִשְׁאֹ֑ב וַתִּשְׁאַ֖ב לְכָל־ גְּמַלָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tə·‘ar kad·dāh ’el- haš·šō·qeṯ wat·tā·rāṣ ‘ō·wḏ ’el- hab·bə·’êr liš·’ōḇ wat·tiš·’aḇ lə·ḵāl gə·mal·lāw
verses.literal: And she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran back to the well to draw water until she had drawn water for all his camels

verses.original: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵ֖ה לָ֑הּ מַחֲרִ֕ישׁ לָדַ֗עַת אִם־ לֹֽא׃ יְהוָ֛ה דַּרְכּ֖וֹ הַֽהִצְלִ֧יחַ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’îš miš·tā·’êh lāh ma·ḥă·rîš lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’im- lō Yah·weh dar·kōw ha·hiṣ·lî·aḥ
verses.literal: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הַגְּמַלִּים֙ כִּלּ֤וּ לִשְׁתּ֔וֹת הָאִישׁ֙ וַיִּקַּ֤ח זָהָ֔ב נֶ֣זֶם מִשְׁקָל֑וֹ בֶּ֖קַע וּשְׁנֵ֤י זָהָ֖ב צְמִידִים֙ עַל־ יָדֶ֔יהָ מִשְׁקָלָֽם׃ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer hag·gə·mal·lîm kil·lū liš·tō·wṯ hā·’îš way·yiq·qaḥ zā·hāḇ ne·zem miš·qā·lōw be·qa‘ ū·šə·nê zā·hāḇ ṣə·mî·ḏîm ‘al- yā·ḏe·hā miš·qā·lām ‘ă·śā·rāh
verses.literal: And after the camels had finished drinking [he] took out a gold ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets for her wrists weighing ten [shekels]

verses.original: מִ֣י בַּת־ אַ֔תְּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ נָ֖א הַגִּ֥ידִי לִ֑י הֲיֵ֧שׁ מָק֥וֹם אָבִ֛יךְ בֵּית־ לָ֖נוּ לָלִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: mî baṯ- ’at way·yō·mer nā hag·gî·ḏî lî hă·yêš mā·qō·wm ’ā·ḇîḵ bêṯ- lā·nū lā·lîn
verses.literal: Whose daughter are you he asked Please tell me is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו אָנֹ֑כִי בַּת־ בְּתוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלְכָּ֕ה יָלְדָ֖ה לְנָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ā·nō·ḵî baṯ- bə·ṯū·’êl ben- ’ă·šer mil·kāh yā·lə·ḏāh lə·nā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: She replied . . . I am the daughter of Bethuel the son that Milcah bore to Nahor

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו עִמָּ֑נוּ גַּם־ רַ֣ב תֶּ֥בֶן גַּם־ מִסְפּ֖וֹא גַּם־ מָק֖וֹם לָלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw ‘im·mā·nū gam- raḇ te·ḇen gam- mis·pō·w gam- mā·qō·wm lā·lūn
verses.literal: Then she added . . . We have . . . plenty of straw and feed as well as a place [for you] to spend the night

verses.original: הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיִּקֹּ֣ד וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš way·yiq·qōḏ way·yiš·ta·ḥū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ עָזַ֥ב חַסְדּ֛וֹ וַאֲמִתּ֖וֹ מֵעִ֣ם אֲדֹנִ֑י אָנֹכִ֗י יְהוָ֔ה נָחַ֣נִי בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ בֵּ֖ית אֲדֹנִֽי׃ אֲחֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer lō- ‘ā·zaḇ ḥas·dōw wa·’ă·mit·tōw mê·‘im ’ă·ḏō·nî ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh nā·ḥa·nî bad·de·reḵ bêṯ ’ă·ḏō·nî ’ă·ḥê
verses.literal: saying Blessed [be] the LORD the God of my master Abraham who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master As for me the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives

verses.original: הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַתָּ֙רָץ֙ וַתַּגֵּ֖ד אִמָּ֑הּ לְבֵ֣ית הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: han·na·‘ă·rā wat·tā·rāṣ wat·tag·gêḏ ’im·māh lə·ḇêṯ hā·’êl·leh kad·də·ḇā·rîm
verses.literal: The girl ran and told her mother’s household about these things

verses.original: וּלְרִבְקָ֥ה אָ֖ח וּשְׁמ֣וֹ לָבָ֑ן לָבָ֧ן וַיָּ֨רָץ הַח֖וּצָה אֶל־ הָאִ֛ישׁ אֶל־ הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·riḇ·qāh ’āḥ ū·šə·mōw lā·ḇān lā·ḇān way·yā·rāṣ ha·ḥū·ṣāh ’el- hā·’îš ’el- hā·‘ā·yin
verses.literal: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban and [he] rushed out to the man at the spring

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־ הַנֶּ֗זֶם וְֽאֶת־ הַצְּמִדִים֮ עַל־ אֲחֹתוֹ֒ יְדֵ֣י וּכְשָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־ אֲחֹתוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר רִבְקָ֤ה דִּבְרֵ֞י הָאִ֑ישׁ דִבֶּ֥ר כֹּֽה־ אֵלַ֖י וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאִ֔ישׁ עֹמֵ֥ד וְהִנֵּ֛ה עַל־ הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים עַל־ הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ōṯ ’eṯ- han·ne·zem wə·’eṯ- haṣ·ṣə·mi·ḏîm ‘al- ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw yə·ḏê ū·ḵə·šā·mə·‘ōw ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw lê·mōr riḇ·qāh diḇ·rê hā·’îš ḏib·ber kōh- ’ê·lay way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·’îš ‘ō·mêḏ wə·hin·nêh ‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm ‘al- hā·‘ā·yin
verses.literal: - As soon as he saw - the ring and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists and heard - - . . . Rebekah’s words The man said this to me he went and found - the man standing - by the camels near the spring

verses.original: בּ֖וֹא בְּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לָ֤מָּה תַעֲמֹד֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְאָנֹכִי֙ פִּנִּ֣יתִי הַבַּ֔יִת וּמָק֖וֹם לַגְּמַלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bō·w bə·rūḵ Yah·weh way·yō·mer lām·māh ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ ba·ḥūṣ wə·’ā·nō·ḵî pin·nî·ṯî hab·ba·yiṯ ū·mā·qō·wm lag·gə·mal·lîm
verses.literal: Come you who are blessed by the LORD said Laban Why are you standing out here I have prepared the house and a place for the camels

verses.original: הָאִישׁ֙ וַיָּבֹ֤א הַבַּ֔יְתָה הַגְּמַלִּ֑ים וַיְפַתַּ֖ח תֶּ֤בֶן וּמִסְפּוֹא֙ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וּמַ֙יִם֙ לִרְחֹ֣ץ רַגְלָ֔יו וְרַגְלֵ֥י הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš way·yā·ḇō hab·bay·ṯāh hag·gə·mal·lîm way·p̄at·taḥ te·ḇen ū·mis·pō·w way·yit·tên lag·gə·mal·lîm ū·ma·yim lir·ḥōṣ raḡ·lāw wə·raḡ·lê hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw
verses.literal: So the man came to the house and the camels were unloaded Straw and feed were brought to the camels and water to wash his feet and the feet of his companions - -

verses.original: וַיִּישֶׂם לְפָנָיו֙ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל לֶאֱכֹ֔ל עַ֥ד אִם־ דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי דְּבָרָ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yī·śɛm lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yō·mer lō ’ō·ḵal le·’ĕ·ḵōl ‘aḏ ’im- dib·bar·tî də·ḇā·rāy way·yō·mer dab·bêr
verses.literal: Then a meal was set before [the man] but he said I will not . . . eat until . . . I have told you what I came to say So Laban said Please speak

verses.original: אָנֹֽכִי׃ אַבְרָהָ֖ם עֶ֥בֶד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ’aḇ·rā·hām ‘e·ḇeḏ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: I am Abraham’s servant he replied

verses.original: וַיהוָ֞ה מְאֹ֖ד בֵּרַ֧ךְ אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֛י וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֞וֹ צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ וְכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וַעֲבָדִם֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וּגְמַלִּ֖ים וַחֲמֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ bê·raḵ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî way·yiḡ·dāl way·yit·ten- lōw ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār wə·ḵe·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏim ū·šə·p̄ā·ḥōṯ ū·ḡə·mal·lîm wa·ḥă·mō·rîm
verses.literal: The LORD has greatly blessed - my master and he has become rich He has given him sheep and cattle silver and gold menservants and maidservants camels and donkeys

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֥י אֵ֨שֶׁת שָׂרָה֩ וַתֵּ֡לֶד לַֽאדֹנִ֔י בֵן֙ אַחֲרֵ֖י זִקְנָתָ֑הּ וַיִּתֶּן־ לּ֖וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nî ’ê·šeṯ śā·rāh wat·tê·leḏ la·ḏō·nî ḇên ’a·ḥă·rê ziq·nā·ṯāh way·yit·ten- lō ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw
verses.literal: My master’s wife Sarah has borne [him] a son in her old age and [my master] has given him - everything he owns -

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֖י וַיַּשְׁבִּעֵ֥נִי לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־ תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃ אָנֹכִ֖י יֹשֵׁ֥ב
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nî way·yaš·bi·‘ê·nî lê·mōr lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî mib·bə·nō·wṯ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’ă·šer bə·’ar·ṣōw ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·šêḇ
verses.literal: My master made me swear an oath and said You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites - in whose land I dwell

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֧א תֵּלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־ אָבִ֛י בֵּית־ וְאֶל־ מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō tê·lêḵ ’el- ’ā·ḇî bêṯ- wə·’el- miš·paḥ·tî wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî
verses.literal: but . . . you shall go to my father’s house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֑י אֻלַ֛י הָאִשָּׁ֖ה לֹא־ תֵלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî ’u·lay hā·’iš·šāh lō- ṯê·lêḵ ’a·ḥă·rāy
verses.literal: Then I asked . . . my master What if the woman will not come back with me

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י יְהוָ֞ה לְפָנָ֗יו אֲשֶׁר־ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי יִשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכ֤וֹ אִתָּךְ֙ דַּרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתִּ֖י אָבִֽי׃ וּמִבֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy Yah·weh lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ă·šer- hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵōw ’it·tāḵ dar·ke·ḵā wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî mim·miš·paḥ·tî ’ā·ḇî ū·mib·bêṯ
verses.literal: And he told me The LORD before whom I have walked will send His angel with you and make your journey a success so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house

verses.original: כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֶל־ מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י תִּנָּקֶה֙ מֵאָ֣לָתִ֔י וְאִם־ לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ לָ֔ךְ אָ֤ז וְהָיִ֥יתָ נָקִ֖י מֵאָלָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯā·ḇō·w ’el- miš·paḥ·tî tin·nā·qeh mê·’ā·lā·ṯî wə·’im- lō yit·tə·nū lāḵ ’āz wə·hā·yî·ṯā nā·qî mê·’ā·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: And when you go to my kindred - - if they refuse to give her to you then you will be released from my oath

verses.original: וָאָבֹ֥א אֶל־ הָעָ֑יִן הַיּ֖וֹם וָאֹמַ֗ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אִם־ יֶשְׁךָ־ נָּא֙ דַּרְכִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י הֹלֵ֥ךְ עָלֶֽיהָ׃ מַצְלִ֣יחַ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·ḇō ’el- hā·‘ā·yin hay·yō·wm wā·’ō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām ’im- yeš·ḵā- nā dar·kî ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî hō·lêḵ ‘ā·le·hā maṣ·lî·aḥ
verses.literal: So when I came to the spring today I prayed O LORD God of my master Abraham if only You would . . . make my journey - - . . . . . . a success

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וְהָיָ֤ה הָֽעַלְמָה֙ הַיֹּצֵ֣את לִשְׁאֹ֔ב וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י אֵלֶ֔יהָ נָ֥א הַשְׁקִֽינִי־ מְעַט־ מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ‘ên ham·mā·yim wə·hā·yāh hā·‘al·māh hay·yō·ṣêṯ liš·’ōḇ wə·’ā·mar·tî ’ê·le·hā nā haš·qî·nî- mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim mik·kad·dêḵ
verses.literal: Here I am standing beside this spring . . . Now [if] a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her Please let me drink a little water from your jar

verses.original: וְאָמְרָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַ֥ם אֶשְׁאָ֑ב לִגְמַלֶּ֖יךָ גַּם־ אַתָּ֣ה הִ֣וא הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֹכִ֥יחַ אֲדֹנִֽי׃ לְבֶן־
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rāh ’ê·lay šə·ṯêh wə·ḡam ’eš·’āḇ liḡ·mal·le·ḵā gam- ’at·tāh hî hā·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer- Yah·weh hō·ḵî·aḥ ’ă·ḏō·nî lə·ḇen-
verses.literal: and she replies . . . Drink . . . and I will draw water for your camels as well . . . may she be the woman - the LORD has appointed for my master’s son

verses.original: טֶ֨רֶם אֲנִי֩ אֲכַלֶּ֜ה לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ לִבִּ֗י וְהִנֵּ֨ה רִבְקָ֤ה יֹצֵאת֙ וְכַדָּ֣הּ עַל־ שִׁכְמָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יְנָה וַתִּשְׁאָ֑ב וָאֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יהָ נָֽא׃ הַשְׁקִ֥ינִי
verses.transliteration: ṭe·rem ’ă·nî ’ă·ḵal·leh lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- lib·bî wə·hin·nêh riḇ·qāh yō·ṣêṯ wə·ḵad·dāh ‘al- šiḵ·māh wat·tê·reḏ hā·‘ay·nāh wat·tiš·’āḇ wā·’ō·mar ’ê·le·hā nā haš·qî·nî
verses.literal: And before I had finished praying in my heart there was Rebekah coming out with her jar on her shoulder and she went down to the spring and drew water So I said to her Please give me a drink

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתּ֤וֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁתֵ֔ה אַשְׁקֶ֑ה גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ וְגַם־ וָאֵ֕שְׁתְּ וְגַ֥ם הִשְׁקָֽתָה׃ הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tō·w·reḏ kad·dāh mê·‘ā·le·hā wat·tō·mer šə·ṯêh ’aš·qeh gə·mal·le·ḵā wə·ḡam- wā·’ê·šət wə·ḡam hiš·qā·ṯāh hag·gə·mal·lîm
verses.literal: She quickly lowered her jar from her [shoulder] and said Drink and I will water your camels as well So I drank and she also watered the camels

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁאַ֣ל אֹתָ֗הּ מִ֣י בַּת־ אַתְּ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר וָאֹמַר֮ בַּת־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־ נָח֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלְכָּ֑ה יָֽלְדָה־ לּ֖וֹ וָאָשִׂ֤ם הַנֶּ֙זֶם֙ עַל־ אַפָּ֔הּ וְהַצְּמִידִ֖ים עַל־ יָדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·’al ’ō·ṯāh mî baṯ- ’at wat·tō·mer wā·’ō·mar baṯ- bə·ṯū·’êl ben- nā·ḥō·wr ’ă·šer mil·kāh yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw wā·’ā·śim han·ne·zem ‘al- ’ap·pāh wə·haṣ·ṣə·mî·ḏîm ‘al- yā·ḏe·hā
verses.literal: Then I asked her - Whose daughter are you . . . She replied The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor whom Milcah bore to him So I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists

verses.original: וָאֶקֹּ֥ד וָֽאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה וָאֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנְחַ֙נִי֙ אֱמֶ֔ת בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לָקַ֛חַת אֶת־ בַּת־ אֲדֹנִ֖י אֲחִ֥י לִבְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qōḏ wā·’eš·ta·ḥă·weh Yah·weh wā·’ă·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer hin·ḥa·nî ’ĕ·meṯ bə·ḏe·reḵ lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- baṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî ’ă·ḥî liḇ·nōw
verses.literal: Then I bowed down and worshiped the LORD and I blessed - the LORD the God of my master Abraham who led me on the right road to take - the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּה אִם־ יֶשְׁכֶ֨ם עֹשִׂ֜ים חֶ֧סֶד וֶֽאֱמֶ֛ת אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֖י הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֑י וְאִם־ לֹ֕א הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֔י וְאֶפְנֶ֥ה עַל־ יָמִ֖ין א֥וֹ עַל־ שְׂמֹֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- yeš·ḵem ‘ō·śîm ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî hag·gî·ḏū lî wə·’im- lō hag·gî·ḏū lî wə·’ep̄·neh ‘al- yā·mîn ’ōw ‘al- śə·mōl
verses.literal: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master tell me but if not let me know - so that I may go elsewhere . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: לָבָ֤ן וּבְתוּאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ וַיַּ֨עַן יָצָ֣א מֵיְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א נוּכַ֛ל דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ רַ֥ע אוֹ־ טֽוֹב׃ הַדָּבָ֑ר
verses.transliteration: lā·ḇān ū·ḇə·ṯū·’êl way·yō·mə·rū way·ya·‘an yā·ṣā Yah·weh lō nū·ḵal dab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā ra‘ ’ōw- ṭō·wḇ had·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Laban and Bethuel . . . answered This is from the LORD we have no choice . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . in the matter

verses.original: רִבְקָ֥ה הִנֵּֽה־ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ קַ֣ח וָלֵ֑ךְ וּתְהִ֤י אִשָּׁה֙ אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ לְבֶן־ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃ דִּבֶּ֥ר

verses.literal: Rebekah is here before you Take her and go and let her become the wife of your master’s son just as the LORD has decreed

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־ עֶ֥בֶד שָׁמַ֛ע דִּבְרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַ֖רְצָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- ‘e·ḇeḏ šā·ma‘ diḇ·rê·hem way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ar·ṣāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: - When Abraham’s - servant heard their words he bowed down to the ground before the LORD

verses.original: הָעֶ֜בֶד וַיּוֹצֵ֨א כְּלֵי־ כֶ֨סֶף וּכְלֵ֤י זָהָב֙ וּבְגָדִ֔ים וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לְרִבְקָ֑ה נָתַ֥ן וּמִ֨גְדָּנֹ֔ת לְאָחִ֖יהָ וּלְאִמָּֽהּ׃

verses.literal: Then he brought out jewels of silver . . . and gold and articles of clothing and he gave them to Rebekah He also gave precious gifts to her brother and her mother

verses.original: ה֛וּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּ֖וֹ וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֗וּ וַיָּלִ֑ינוּ וַיָּק֣וּמוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שַׁלְּחֻ֥נִי לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃

verses.literal: Then he and the men - with him ate and drank and spent the night there When they got up the next morning he said Send me on my way to my master

verses.original: אָחִ֙יהָ֙ וְאִמָּ֔הּ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַנַּעֲרָ֥ תֵּשֵׁ֨ב אִתָּ֛נוּ עָשׂ֑וֹר יָמִ֖ים א֣וֹ אַחַ֖ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥî·hā wə·’im·māh way·yō·mer han·na·‘ă·rā tê·šêḇ ’it·tā·nū ‘ā·śō·wr yā·mîm ’ōw ’a·ḥar tê·lêḵ
verses.literal: But her brother and mother said Let the girl remain with us ten days or so After that she may go

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַל־ תְּאַחֲר֣וּ אֹתִ֔י וַֽיהוָ֖ה דַּרְכִּ֑י הִצְלִ֣יחַ שַׁלְּח֕וּנִי וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’al- tə·’a·ḥă·rū ’ō·ṯî Yah·weh dar·kî hiṣ·lî·aḥ šal·lə·ḥū·nî wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh la·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: But he replied . . . Do not delay me - since the LORD has made my journey a success Send me on my way so that I may go to my master

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ נִקְרָ֣א לַֽנַּעֲרָ֑ וְנִשְׁאֲלָ֖ה אֶת־ פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū niq·rā lan·na·‘ă·rā wə·niš·’ă·lāh ’eṯ- pî·hā
verses.literal: So they said We will call the girl and ask - her opinion

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְרִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ הֲתֵלְכִ֖י עִם־ הַזֶּ֑ה הָאִ֣ישׁ אֵלֵֽךְ׃ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū lə·riḇ·qāh way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·le·hā hă·ṯê·lə·ḵî ‘im- haz·zeh hā·’îš ’ê·lêḵ wat·tō·mer
verses.literal: They called Rebekah and asked her Will you go with this man I will go she replied

verses.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֛וּ אֶת־ אֲחֹתָ֖ם וְאֶת־ רִבְקָ֥ה מֵנִקְתָּ֑הּ וְאֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְאֶת־ עֶ֥בֶד אֲנָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·lə·ḥū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- riḇ·qāh mê·niq·tāh wə·’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·’eṯ- ‘e·ḇeḏ ’ă·nā·šāw
verses.literal: So they sent - their sister - Rebekah {on her way} along with her nurse - and Abraham’s - servant and his men

verses.original: וַיְבָרֲכ֤וּ אֶת־ רִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לָ֔הּ אֲחֹתֵ֕נוּ אַ֥תְּ הֲיִ֖י לְאַלְפֵ֣י רְבָבָ֑ה זַרְעֵ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת וְיִירַ֣שׁ שַׁ֥עַר שֹׂנְאָֽיו׃

verses.literal: And they blessed - Rebekah and said to her Our sister may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands May your offspring - possess the gates of their enemies

verses.original: רִבְקָ֜ה וְנַעֲרֹתֶ֗יהָ וַתָּ֨קָם וַתִּרְכַּ֙בְנָה֙ עַל־ הַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וַתֵּלַ֖כְנָה אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאִ֑ישׁ הָעֶ֛בֶד אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֥ח רִבְקָ֖ה וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃

verses.literal: Then Rebekah and her servant girls got ready mounted . . . the camels and followed . . . the man So the servant - took Rebekah and left

verses.original: וְיִצְחָק֙ בָּ֣א מִבּ֔וֹא בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י וְה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב הַנֶּֽגֶב׃ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ
verses.transliteration: wə·yiṣ·ḥāq bā mib·bō·w bə·’êr la·ḥay rō·’î wə·hū yō·wō·šêḇ han·ne·ḡeḇ bə·’e·reṣ
verses.literal: Now Isaac had just returned from vvv vvv Beer-lahai-roi for he was living in the Negev . . .

verses.original: עָ֑רֶב יִצְחָ֛ק וַיֵּצֵ֥א בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לָשׂ֥וּחַ לִפְנ֣וֹת וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּ֥ה גְמַלִּ֖ים בָּאִֽים׃

verses.literal: Early in the evening Isaac went out to the field to meditate . . . and looking up . . . he saw . . . the camels approaching

verses.original: רִבְקָה֙ וַתִּשָּׂ֤א אֶת־ עֵינֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֖רֶא אֶת־ יִצְחָ֑ק וַתִּפֹּ֖ל מֵעַ֥ל הַגָּמָֽל׃

verses.literal: And when Rebekah looked up - - and saw - Isaac she got down from her camel

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ הָעֶ֗בֶד מִֽי־ הַלָּזֶה֙ הָאִ֤ישׁ בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ הַהֹלֵ֤ךְ לִקְרָאתֵ֔נוּ ה֣וּא אֲדֹנִ֑י הָעֶ֖בֶד וַיֹּ֥אמֶר וַתִּקַּ֥ח הַצָּעִ֖יף וַתִּתְכָּֽס׃

verses.literal: and asked . . . the servant Who is that man in the field coming to meet us It is my master the servant answered So she took her veil and covered herself

verses.original: הָעֶ֖בֶד וַיְסַפֵּ֥ר לְיִצְחָ֑ק אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃

verses.literal: Then the servant told Isaac - all . . . that he had done

verses.original: יִצְחָ֗ק וַיְבִאֶ֣הָ הָאֹ֙הֱלָה֙ אִמּ֔וֹ שָׂרָ֣ה וַיִּקַּ֧ח אֶת־ רִבְקָ֛ה וַתְּהִי־ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֖ה יִצְחָ֖ק וַיֶּאֱהָבֶ֑הָ וַיִּנָּחֵ֥ם אַחֲרֵ֥י אִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq way·ḇi·’e·hā hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh ’im·mōw śā·rāh way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- riḇ·qāh wat·tə·hî- lōw lə·’iš·šāh yiṣ·ḥāq way·ye·’ĕ·hā·ḇe·hā way·yin·nā·ḥêm ’a·ḥă·rê ’im·mōw
verses.literal: And Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah and took - Rebekah as his wife And Isaac loved her and was comforted after his mother’s death
